# A booking page you host yourself, with no per-seat fee.

> A booking page you host yourself: weekly hours, buffers, notice, your calendar's busy time respected, time zones, calendar invites, reminders and cancel or reschedule links. Open source, MIT, no per-seat fee. Try the slot finder in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/slot-keeper/)
